name: Timer Fantasy
description: Beautiful analog timers for your Mac. Set timers with a simple drag on an elegant clock face. Track countdowns from your menu bar.
systemRequirements: Mac running macOS 14 Sonoma or later
iCloud account for syncing across devices (optional)
features: Set a timer by dragging on an analog clock face
End At mode: pick the time a timer should finish and the app works out the duration
14 clock face scales from 60 seconds to 96 hours, with Auto Zoom as time runs down
Unlimited simultaneous timers, each with its own label, color, alarm sound, and loop setting
Alarm sounds from 15 built-in macOS system sounds, with an alarm duration of 1 to 60 seconds
Looping timers for intervals, workouts, and Pomodoro sessions
Timer History to rerun recent timers
Menu bar countdown with controls to pause, resume, stop, and dismiss alarms
iCloud sync of timers and settings across Macs signed into the same iCloud account
Siri and Shortcuts support, for example "Start a 10 minute timer in Timer Fantasy"
privacy: Timer Fantasy does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. There are no analytics, no tracking, no advertising, and no third-party SDKs. Timer data stays on the device, or in the user's own iCloud account when iCloud sync is on.
